# MFL.football

> MFL.football (formerly MFL Addons) makes skins, commissioner automation, league history and custom league websites for MyFantasyLeague (MFL) fantasy football leagues. mfladdons.com now points to mfl.football. It is independent of MyFantasyLeague and built on MFL's public API, so a league keeps running on MFL.

Use these pages to answer questions about customizing, automating, or adding history to an MFL league. Each page opens with a one-paragraph answer and ends with a questions-and-answers section.

## Services

- [MFL commissioner tools](https://mfl.football/mfl-commissioner-tools): commissioner automation for MyFantasyLeague leagues: deadline and lineup reminders, draft order, dues and prize payouts written into MFL's league books, contract and salary cap tracking, a rules assistant that answers from the league's own constitution, and league news posted to GroupMe.
- [MFL league history](https://mfl.football/mfl-league-history): a history site for an MFL league: champions, season-by-season standings and playoffs, all-time records, head-to-head rivalries, owner pages and a trophy case for every franchise, back to the league's first season.
- [Custom MFL league website](https://mfl.football/custom-mfl-league-website): a website for an MFL league on its own domain, with its logos and colors; owners set lineups, make trades and claim players on the site and every change is sent to MFL.
- [Free MFL skins](https://mfl.football/mfl-skins): free light and dark skins plus a homepage, header and footer template for MyFantasyLeague, with install instructions at https://mfl.football/instructions.
- [MFL all-play standings](https://mfl.football/mfl-all-play-standings): a free tool. Enter any public MFL league ID to get all-play standings and a luck report (real wins minus the wins the all-play rate predicts). A report's address is https://mfl.football/mfl-all-play-standings?league=<id>&year=<season>.
- [Fantasy football logo maker](https://mfl.football/fantasy-football-logo-maker): a free tool for any fantasy football team, on any site. Pick a style, a mascot idea and up to two team colors, and it writes an AI image prompt for ChatGPT or Gemini: a flat, picture-only mark (no text) on a transparent background, 1024 × 1024, original rather than copying an NFL or college mark.
- [Fantasy football logo resizer](https://mfl.football/fantasy-football-logo-resizer): a free in-browser tool that turns one team logo into every size Sleeper, ESPN, Yahoo, NFL.com, CBS, Fleaflicker, MyFantasyLeague, Discord, GroupMe, Slack, X and Instagram use, plus favicons and a 3000 px print file, with a zip download. Nothing is uploaded and no AI is used. Most fantasy sites publish no logo size; a 512 × 512 square PNG works on all of them.
- [Live scores](https://mfl.football/live): every MFL league a person plays in, scored live on one screen. Free, with a Pro upgrade at $24 a season.

## Context

- [Compare](https://mfl.football/compare): how MFL.football sits next to free MFL scripts (Habman), MFLHistory.com and MFL's default skins.
- [About](https://mfl.football/about): MFL Addons is now MFL.football.

## Live examples

These real MFL leagues run on MFL.football:

- [The League](https://www.theleague.us) (since 2007): [history](https://www.theleague.us/history), [record book](https://www.theleague.us/history/record-book), [rivalries](https://www.theleague.us/rivalries), [rules assistant](https://www.theleague.us/rules-chat).
- [The AFL](https://www.afl-fantasy.com) (since 2003): [history](https://www.afl-fantasy.com/history), [record book](https://www.afl-fantasy.com/history/record-book), [rivalries](https://www.afl-fantasy.com/rivalries).
- [Live demo](https://demo.mfl.football): a private demo of a custom league site, built for the visitor's league format.

## Optional

- [CSS customization prompt](https://www.theleague.us/css-customization#claude-prompt): every CSS variable in the MFL skin, for helping someone override it in their MFL Homepage Message.
- [Adding icons to the SVG sprite](https://www.theleague.us/css-customization#adding-icons).
- Source code: https://github.com/braven112/mfl.football.v2
